Medium and olive skin tones: anchor at #FB8A35 — a bright warm orange sitting exactly halfway between the fair and deep anchors, clear and vivid with a balanced yellow warmth

On medium and olive skin tones the orange must read as bright and clear — balanced between the punchy fair anchor and the electric deep anchor, never muddy, dark, coral-shifted, or heavy.
